info.title: Kadé gateway-admin
info.description: Backend-for-frontend REST API for the Kadé Ops console (apps/admin). Staff only (ops, finance, support, admin); each write is checked against the role → permission matrix and audited. Money is whole rupees (LKR); instants are epoch milliseconds; restaurant ids are numbers. Errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`. Mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Realtime: WebSocket /ws (see the gateway README).
